blocks.html: There’s a saying that good things come in threes, and Robinsons Offices proves this with the completion of Cybergate Iloilo Tower 3 in the progressive municipality of Pavia, Iloilo.

On January 23, 2025, Robinsons Offices inaugurated Cybergate Iloilo Tower 3, the tallest office block in the complex, with the event “1, 2, 3 Lights On.” The date—01/23—celebrated the completion of the three-tower development, which has helped modernize Pavia from a quiet agricultural town into a bustling economic hub. The launch also unveiled Robinsons Aqua Blue (RAB) Façade Lights, illuminating all three towers and creating a captivating skyline that highlights the complex as a symbol of progress and innovation in Western Visayas.

With its completion, the Robinsons Cybergate Iloilo complex signals greater things ahead for Pavia and the wider Western Visayas region. Offering stability and opportunity in a fast-evolving world, the complex is set to remain a key driver of Pavia’s progress—a sustainable, future-ready business hub where Iloilo’s citizens can live, work, play, and seek inspiration in the years ahead.
A Prime Destination for Businesses

The Cybergate Iloilo Towers, situated in an 8-hectare development in Pavia, caters to the needs of BPOs, IT companies, and traditional businesses. Tower 1 offers five floors of office space, Tower 2 has eight, while Tower 3 boasts 12 floors, with all towers providing premium office facilities with state-of-the-art amenities. With scenic views of Iloilo’s charming landscape and tree-lined countryside, the towers offer an inspiring environment for innovation and productivity.

With the Pavia Transport Terminal conveniently located within the complex, the development offers seamless connectivity to Iloilo City and nearby municipalities such as Jaro and Molo. It is also the closest BPO-grade office development to the Iloilo International Airport, providing unrivaled convenience for businesses with regional or global operations.
Pavia: A Thriving, Progressive and Sustainable Community

Once known for its agriculture, Pavia is now a growing center of commerce, offering exceptional employment opportunities that allow residents to work closer to home. This shift not only boosts the local economy but also enhances the municipality’s reputation as a progressive community.

“The development of Cybergate Iloilo has opened doors for countless Ilonggos,” shares Marielle, a recent college graduate from Iloilo City. “Now, I can pursue my career here without having to move to another city. It’s exciting to be part of a community that values growth and sustainability.”

This reflects Robinsons Offices’ commitment to pursue sustainable and responsible development. Features like LED lighting, an on-site sewage treatment plant, and future-proof infrastructure ensure that the complex is environmentally friendly and cost-efficient for tenants. Common areas promote wellness and work-life balance, fostering a vibrant community within the development.

“With projects such as Cybergate Iloilo that stimulate job creation in the region, Robinsons Offices helps promote the reverse migration effect, which in turn keeps many Filipino families together while serving as agents to nation-building and economic development,” says Jericho P. Go, Senior Vice President & General Manager of Robinsons Offices. “Our mission is to provide high-quality workspaces closer to home, ensuring families remain united while contributing to the growth of their communities.”
The Cybergate Iloilo Towers are now lighting up Pavia like never before.
1, 2, 3, Lights On! Robinsons Land Executives, Iloilo Local Government Officials, and Contractors all came together to launch the Robinsons Aqua Blue Façade Lights last January 23, 2025.

This celebration marks a new era of growth in Iloilo - bringing premium office spaces, job opportunities, and sustainable development to the region. With world-class facilities and strategic location, Robinsons Offices supports business growth and keeping families together.
